findings.title: Default-strategy test path never enables rolling-updates in the CR; the custom image build hides it
findings.body: createInitialDeployment returns early when updateStrategy == null, before FeatureSpec.setEnabledFeatures(rolling-updates) is applied. The `null` case of testImageChange and testCacheMaxCount therefore runs without the feature in the CR. It only works because Dockerfile-custom-image now builds the image with `--features=rolling-updates`. The new operator docs say the feature must be enabled, "Otherwise, the Operator will fail", and that is how the default-strategy case is documented. The test neither verifies this nor matches it, and the image-level flag makes the CR-level setting redundant. A regression in how the feature gets enabled would not be caught. Apply the feature setting to both branches, or add a test that the update fails or reports a clear status when the feature is off.

findings.title: Feature-disabled behaviour only checked for `metadata`, and the new exit code 4 is never asserted
findings.body: The new FEATURE_DISABLED exit code (4) is a scripting contract documented in update-compatibility.adoc. testFeatureNotEnabled only checks the error text for the `metadata` subcommand and does not assert the exit code. The `check` subcommand has the same guard and no disabled-feature test. A regression that exits with 0 or 1, or drops the early return in `check`, would pass. Add assertions that the exit code is 4 for both subcommands. Also cover the renumbered RECREATE exit code (now 3) in testWrongVersions.

findings.title: Macro hard-codes `--features=rolling-updates`, conflicting with the "use all your start options" instruction
findings.body: The updatecompatibility macro appends a fixed `--features=rolling-updates` to every rendered example. The guide tells users to pass all the options they use with `start`, including `--features=...` in most real deployments. Following both instructions yields two `--features` options. Picocli rejects that or silently overrides one. Either way the metadata is computed against a different feature set than the running server, which is the case the warning in the guide describes. The guide should say that `rolling-updates` must be added to the existing feature list, rather than showing it as an extra standalone flag.
